changes: Fresh reservation, model/source/host/arm/output bindings; no old prior-unit-state assumptions.
Existing host supervisor owns native lifecycle, both locks, 90-second AppReady bound, 1200-second native bound, foreign-CUDA monitor, raw-contact audit and exact cleanup.

Guard preflight locks are released before supervisor dispatch to avoid nested flock; supervisor reacquires both and reruns reservation/resource preflight before creation. Guard reacquires for post-exit verification.
Only supervisor preflight/resource callbacks gain reservation checks; run_owned and its cleanup are not reimplemented.
A separate exact-owned-container fallback is available for bounded systemd ExecStopPost cleanup.
limitation: slurmd.service remained active with zero recorded children after a stop attempt required interactive authentication. Identified masks are not absolute producer isolation; preserve actual startup/runtime foreign-CUDA detection.
